svg.aria-label: host protocol: weight load then inference trigger
svg.text: one weight-tile load (LD_W plus 8 payload bytes) followed by RUN with requantization
Orange = command byte (is_cmd high), blue = payload byte. Writes while busy are rejected and set the sticky error flag.
busy rises two cycles after the RUN byte: one to register the command, one for the sequencer to start.
